Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to hear more about Acme's latency targets and how you currently batch inference. As discussed, the best next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra leads so we can:

- Walk through your current model architecture and inference stack (models, KV cache usage, autoscaling patterns)
- Share Redwood's runtime optimizations and quantization options relevant to your workloads
- Review sample request/response shapes, typical sequence lengths, and cost/latency expectations
- Define a mutual action plan and success criteria for a pilot

Suggested times (PDT):
- Thu Apr 15, 10:00–11:30 AM
- Fri Apr 16, 9:00–10:30 AM
- Mon Apr 19, 1:00–2:30 PM

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your side will join (ML lead, infra/ops, data security if possible). I can include our infra engineer (Camila) and a solutions engineer for the session.

Attaching the post-discovery notes and a short pre-meeting questionnaire that helps us prepare.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
